# CupDate (cupdate.in) — World's Best Free Coffee Dating, CupTV Live Video & Café Reviews

> CupDate is a 100% free, safe, moderated coffee dating, friendship, and live video chat platform across 200+ Indian cities and worldwide.

## Key Free Features
- **100% Free Forever ($0)**: Profile creation, discovery, 1-to-1 chat, CupTV live video, Coffee Moments, and Café Reviews are all free without paid paywalls.
- **CupTV Live Video** (https://cupdate.in/live-video): Instant 1-to-1 encrypted WebRTC random & filtered live video chat across India and global hubs.
- **Women-Friendly Café Reviews** (https://cupdate.in/cafes): Honest reviews of daytime cafés with safety tags, ratings, and social sharing.
- **Shareable Coffee Moments** (https://cupdate.in/moments): Members and women share café & travel moments safely across WhatsApp, Instagram, X, and Facebook.
- **Anti-Nudity & Anti-Spam Protection** (https://cupdate.in/safety): Automated text and image moderation plus role-based human review.
